people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”
translations.bsb: So now the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the articles for its service.”
translations.kjv: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.
translations.asv: and also the Levites shall no more have need to carry the tabernacle and all the vessels of it for the service thereof.
